test.create_query: CREATE TABLE mut_src ( WatchID UInt64, EventTime DateTime, EventDate Date, CounterID UInt32, UserID UInt64, RegionID UInt32, ResolutionWidth UInt16, ResolutionHeight UInt16, IsMobile UInt8, TraficSourceID Int8, SearchEngineID UInt16, AdvEngineID UInt8, URL String, Title String, Referer String, SearchPhrase String ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 8 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS enable_block_number_column = 1, enable_block_offset_column = 1, old_parts_lifetime = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO mut_src SELECT WatchID, EventTime, EventDate, CounterID, UserID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, IsMobile, TraficSourceID, SearchEngineID, AdvEngineID, URL, Title, Referer, SearchPhrase FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
ALTER TABLE mut_src MODIFY SETTING lock_acquire_timeout_for_background_operations = 600
OPTIMIZE TABLE mut_src FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
SYSTEM STOP MERGES mut_src
SELECT throwIf(count() != 8) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'mut_src' AND active

SELECT throwIf((count(), countIf(IsMobile = 1), countIf(AdvEngineID != 0), countIf(SearchEngineID = 0), countIf(URL = 'http://no.such.host/zqxjkvwy'), countIf(AdvEngineID != 0 AND Title != upper(Title))) != (100000000, 10172637, 630535, 84857038, 0, 223701)) FROM mut_src
ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, DELETE WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND intHash32(UserID) % 8 < 2 SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(WatchID))) != (SELECT countIf(NOT (IsMobile = 1 AND intHash32(UserID) % 8 < 2)), sumIf(cityHash64(WatchID), NOT (IsMobile = 1 AND intHash32(UserID) % 8 < 2)) FROM mut_src)) FROM mut
ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, DELETE WHERE URL = 'http://no.such.host/zqxjkvwy' SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(URL))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM mut_src)) FROM mut
ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, UPDATE ResolutionWidth = ResolutionWidth + 1 WHERE SearchEngineID = 0 SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf(sum(ResolutionWidth) != (SELECT sum(ResolutionWidth) + 84857038 FROM mut_src)) FROM mut
ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, UPDATE Title = upper(Title) WHERE AdvEngineID != 0 SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf(sum(cityHash64(Title)) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(if(AdvEngineID != 0, upper(Title), Title))) FROM mut_src)) FROM mut
CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src
DELETE FROM mut_lw WHERE IsMobile = 1 SETTINGS lightweight_delete_mode = 'alter_update', lightweight_deletes_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), countIf(IsMobile = 1)) != (89827363, 0)) FROM mut_lw
DROP TABLE mut_lw SYNC
CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src
DELETE FROM mut_lw WHERE IsMobile = 1 SETTINGS lightweight_delete_mode = 'lightweight_update_force'
SELECT throwIf((count(), countIf(IsMobile = 1)) != (89827363, 0)) FROM mut_lw
DROP TABLE mut_lw SYNC
CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src
UPDATE mut_lw SET Title = upper(Title) WHERE AdvEngineID != 0
SELECT throwIf(sum(cityHash64(Title)) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(if(AdvEngineID != 0, upper(Title), Title))) FROM mut_src)) FROM mut_lw
DROP TABLE mut_lw SYNC
test.query: ${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --mutations_sync 2 --query "ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, DELETE WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND intHash32(UserID) % 8 < 2"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --mutations_sync 2 --query "ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, DELETE WHERE URL = 'http://no.such.host/zqxjkvwy'"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --mutations_sync 2 --query "ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, UPDATE ResolutionWidth = ResolutionWidth + 1 WHERE SearchEngineID = 0"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --mutations_sync 2 --query "ALTER TABLE mut DROP PARTITION ALL, ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM mut_src, UPDATE Title = upper(Title) WHERE AdvEngineID != 0"

${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --lightweight_delete_mode alter_update --lightweight_deletes_sync 2 --query "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mut_lw SYNC; CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src; DELETE FROM mut_lw WHERE IsMobile = 1"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --lightweight_delete_mode lightweight_update_force --query "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mut_lw SYNC; CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src; DELETE FROM mut_lw WHERE IsMobile = 1"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --query "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mut_lw SYNC; CREATE TABLE mut_lw CLONE AS mut_src; UPDATE mut_lw SET Title = upper(Title) WHERE AdvEngineID != 0"
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mut_lw, mut, mut_src SYNC
